mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_alert_config ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, status_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT '状态码', status_label VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '状态显示名', threshold_days INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 COMMENT '持续天数阈值', enabled TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 COMMENT '是否启用', created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
ALTER TABLE cage_alert_config ADD COLUMN mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' AFTER enabled
ALTER TABLE cage_alert_config DROP INDEX status_code
ALTER TABLE cage_alert_config ADD UNIQUE KEY uk_code_mode (status_code, mode)
mapper.select: SELECT id, status_code AS statusCode, status_label AS statusLabel, threshold_days AS thresholdDays, enabled, mode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cage_alert_config WHERE enabled = 1 AND mode = #{mode} ORDER BY id
